text: dsh-imagegen-skill 是面向 DSH Web 会话的图像生成与编辑技能插件。它通过 Cordis skills 注册器把 imagegen 技能放入会话目录，用户可调用技能或运行随包 CLI。功能包括文字生成图片、参考图编辑、JSONL 批量生成、透明背景处理和输出图片缩放。适合需要为项目制作插画、界面稿或图片素材的 DSH 用户。真实请求需要 OPENAI_API_KEY 和兼容 GPT Image 的图像端点。

dsh-imagegen-skill adds imagegen to DSH web sessions through the skills service. Its CLI generates images from prompts, edits reference images, and processes JSONL batches. It also supports transparent assets. Real requests require OPENAI_API_KEY and a compatible GPT Image endpoint.
想用文字描述直接为项目生成图片素材
我想把现有图片交给 DSH 按提示修改
需要从一批 JSONL 提示一次生成多张图
怎么给生成的图片做成透明背景素材
想用参考图和遮罩局部编辑图像
I need to generate project artwork from text prompts
Can I edit an existing image with a prompt and mask?
I want to create images from a JSONL batch of jobs
dsh-imagegen-skill 的功能「图片生成功能：根据提示词生成一张或多张 GPT Image 图片，可指定尺寸、质量、格式和输出位置；支持预览请求参数。通过 generate 命令触发。
dsh-imagegen-skill 的功能「参考图编辑功能：输入一张或多张图片、提示词及可选 PNG 遮罩，生成编辑结果并保存到指定路径。通过 edit 命令触发。
dsh-imagegen-skill 的功能「批量生成功能：读取 JSONL 中的任务并并发提交，支持设置并发数、重试次数和失败时停止。通过 generate-batch 命令触发。
dsh-imagegen-skill 的功能「输出后处理功能：可在保存生成结果时额外产出缩小版本，便于网页加载；输出格式支持 PNG、JPEG 或 WebP。通过 downscale 与 output-format 参数控制。
dsh-imagegen-skill 须配置 OPENAI_API_KEY 才能发送真实图像请求；dry-run 无需密钥或网络。见 skills/imagegen/scripts/image_gen.py:69-76。

Bundled **imagegen** skill for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness): one `dsh plugin add` puts image generation and image editing in every session's skill catalog — no copying files into `$DSH_HOME/skills` by hand.

> 用着还行的话，点个 ⭐ 就够了——插件市场的「搜插件」按 GitHub star 排序，star 是这个插件能被人翻到的唯一杠杆。

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-imagegen-skill
```

dsh-imagegen-skill README · dsh-imagegen-skill：After a restart the agent can load the skill with the `skill` tool (or you can invoke it with `/imagegen`), and it will generate or edit raster images through the CLI that ships with this package.

dsh-imagegen-skill README · What it does：The skill teaches the agent to drive `scripts/image_gen.py` — a small `openai`-SDK CLI — against any OpenAI-compatible endpoint that serves GPT Image:

- `generate` — text to image, including transparent-background cutouts
- `edit` — one or more reference images in, one image out (image-to-image, chain edits)
- `generate-batch` — many jobs from a JSONL file, only when you explicitly ask for CLI/API/model control
dsh-imagegen-skill README · What it does：Artifacts land in the project (`output/imagegen/` by default), never in a temp directory, and never overwrite an existing asset unless you ask.

dsh-imagegen-skill README · Configuration：| Variable | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `OPENAI_API_KEY` | Credential for your endpoint. Required for real calls. |
| `OPENAI_BASE_URL` | Base URL of an OpenAI-compatible `/v1` root. Leave unset for `api.openai.com`. |

dsh-imagegen-skill README · Configuration：Any relay works as long as it exposes `/v1/images/generations`: the official API, an Azure-style gateway, a company proxy, or a local relay in front of a ChatGPT subscription. Billing follows whatever that endpoint charges — a subscription relay spends subscription quota, not API credit, and surfaces exhaustion as `429 usage_limit_reached` with `resets_in_seconds` in the body.

`--dry-run` validates arguments and the real output path with no key, no network, and no cost.

dsh-imagegen-skill README · Requirement：On Windows the `python` on `PATH` is often the Microsoft Store placeholder with no real interpreter. Install [`uv`](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/) and let the skill load dependencies per run:

```powershell
$env:OPENAI_BASE_URL = "https://api.openai.com/v1"
$env:OPENAI_API_KEY  = "<your key>"
uv run --quiet --with openai python scripts/image_gen.py generate --prompt "a small red dot on white" --size 1024x1024 --out out.png
```
dsh-imagegen-skill README · Requirement：Distribution requires `dsh plugin add` to reach npm or GitHub; nothing else is needed, because this package ships plain JavaScript and no build step.

dsh-imagegen-skill README · Layout：```
package.json          dsh.bundle.patch -> cordis.patch.yml (inserts this plugin into the web composition)
cordis.patch.yml      the insert row
src/index.js          Cordis plugin: registers the bundled skill on ctx.skills
skills/imagegen/

`src/index.js` registers a provider on the skill registry (`ctx.skills.registerProvider`) with `resourceBase` pointing at `skills/imagegen/`, so relative paths in `SKILL.md` resolve against the installed copy wherever `node_modules` happens to be.

dsh-imagegen-skill README · Install from a local checkout：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add D:\Projects\dsh-imagegen-skill
dsh plugin --profile web list
```

dsh-imagegen-skill README · Uninstall：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-imagegen-skill
```

dsh-imagegen-skill README · Note on shadowing a hand-installed copy：A hand-installed `$DSH_HOME/skills/imagegen` and this package both register a skill named `imagegen`. The packaged provider uses the standard packaged rank (600) and the filesystem user root ranks lower (400), so the packaged copy wins and the registry logs a notice about the ignored duplicate. Keep one of the two: if you install this package, remove the hand-copied directory (or the reverse).
